detail.defaultWhy: Run at your own pace without letting low energy or rest become reasons for discouragement.

blueprint.title: Three Energy Action Blueprints
blueprint.description: Adjust the action load to your energy and keep the rhythm connected
blueprint.highEmpty: No high-energy action yet. Add a focused action for demanding days.
blueprint.highDescription: When energy is high, concentrate and make one clear move forward.
blueprint.normalEmpty: No baseline action yet. Add a sustainable everyday action.
blueprint.normalDescription: Keep moving at a familiar pace without adding extra pressure.
blueprint.lowEmpty: No micro action yet, such as reading one page or writing one line.
blueprint.lowDescription: A safe fallback for tired or busy days that keeps you connected.

journal.title: Habit Footprint & Flow Journal
journal.description: Capture each reflection and leave a seed for tomorrow
journal.emptyDescription: Every small action leaves a mark. Log once today and let the rhythm grow from here.

streaks.actionStreakSub: Consecutive days with valid actions (High/Normal/Low). Rest preserves streak without reset.
streaks.rhythmStreakSub: Includes valid actions and intentional Rest days, reflecting your continuous life connection.
streaks.longestStreakSub: Longest action streak achieved on this habit.

trendChart.descHabit: Tap a date to view the record
trendChart.descQuit: Weekly logged occurrences. Unchecked days appear as gaps without assuming zero.
trendChart.descTodo: Completion rate trends across each time window.
trendChart.tooltipNoRecordNote: Missing check-in cannot be inferred as zero occurrences.
trendChart.tooltipZeroNote: Complete records for this week with 0 occurrences.
trendChart.tooltipGeneralNote: Objective mindful recording to stay steady.
trendChart.tapDay: Select a date to view details
trendChart.unloggedNote: There is no record for this day. You can reconnect whenever you are ready.
trendChart.resilienceNote: Micro actions and rest are well balanced, giving your rhythm resilience.
trendChart.fullEnergyNote: This is a high-energy stretch. Stay focused and switch to a micro action when needed.
